references.text: The context of the ransom - every man shall give a ransom for his soul to the Lord when they are counted
The principle that the poor shall be assessed according to their ability regarding vows to the Lord
God shows no partiality between rich and poor, for they are all the work of His hands
Rich and poor meet together; the Lord has made them both
Paul teaches about equality in giving - he who had much did not have too much, and he who had little was not in need
In Christ there is no distinction - neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female
Redemption from an empty life came not with perishable things like silver or gold, but with the precious blood of Christ
